title: tdma_beacon: wire format doc is valuable
description: The module-level doc comment in rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs (lines 1-18) provides a complete byte-offset table documenting the 24-byte header and 48-byte signature layout. This maps exactly to the parse/serialize implementation and makes the binary protocol auditable without reading code. Worth defending if anyone suggests removing as 'redundant' - it serves as the single source of truth for the wire format.
